name: The One
source:
Thrust into the spotlight as the lead of a popular reality dating show, you face romance, intrigue, and the unveiling of deep, dark secrets. 

Will giving away pieces of your heart lead you to true love?

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/The_One_Volume_1]romance-club.fandom[/url]
translation:
作为热门真人秀约会节目的主角，你成为众人瞩目的焦点，你将面对浪漫、阴谋，并揭开深刻、黑暗的秘密。

放弃你的心会让你收获真爱吗？
